title: Headless Dead Money Act 3 fight branch (DeadMoney.esm): the heist chain with Dog killed in the kitchen (NVDLC01MQ03a 60), Curtain Call as the heist chain walks it, Christine killed in the suites (NVDLC01MQ03c 30); docs/handoff/mq-walkthrough-2026-10-27.md

actions.text: The first part is the Dead Money heist chain's own (dead-money-heist.actions.json); this branch kills Dog in the kitchen instead of the deal (Put the Beast Down 60) and Christine in the suites (Last Luxuries 30). It ends there: Heist of the Centuries needs all three Act 3 quests done.

Placed in NVDLC01Lobby as the heist chain is (given): part 1's knockout leaves the player there; without it the pilot started from wherever the campaign left the player and walked the companions' MoveTos from the Mojave (round 15: steps 1-3 timed out, 240 s each [observed: pilot log]). Dean, Christine and Dog reach their wings by NVDLC01MQ02 stage 50's script (MoveTo), not by a walk: their packages for those markers apply only once they are in NVDLC01Suites / NVDLC01Restaurant [observed: round 12 triage]. Done as the script does them.

The casino switch is inside the Electrical Closet (NVDLC01ElectricalCloset: lock level 255, no key [observed: DeadMoney.esm REFR 0x010059C4 XLOC]). Its one opener is the Unlock Electrical Closet Door entry of the upstairs Security Management Control Terminal (HoloCasinoTerminalBSecurity, NVDLC01HoloCasinoTerminalB, Hard; the entry's script is NVDLC01ElectricalCloset.unlock [observed: TERM 0x0100636F]). The way up to it runs about 2200 units inside the 768-unit radius of a destructible speaker (NVDLC01SpeakerDest 0x0100D50A, health 1): a player shoots the speaker, hacks the terminal and picks the entry. Stand-in: the entry's own line (no hacking game, no speaker). Without it the player went the long way to the terminal, stood in the speaker's radius and the collar went off (rounds 15, both Act 3 chains [observed: pilot logs]); the headless run needs no door, its MoveTo goes through it.

actions.label: the closet unlocked from the security terminal

actions.text: Put the Beast Down (NVDLC01MQ03a). The player throws the casino floor's switch (OnActivate): the holograms go down, the three wings unlock, and MQ03a 10 starts Curtain Call and Last Luxuries (MQ03b and MQ03c 10).
The player finds the kitchen manager's key in the restaurant (looting stand-in: added); the quest script sees it (stage 20).

TTW's start-up packs (Classic, Mercenary, Caravan, Tribal: 'Pack items added to inventory.') queue their message boxes; a player closes them as they come; left open, they hold back the kitchen's scripts (its setup activator's first GameMode, which puts Dog away until the gas trigger) and each valve's box answers the pack box in front of it [observed: headless trace, menu 1001 open from frame 300].
The player shuts the kitchen's three gas valves (each a message box, button 1); with all three shut and Dog alive, stage 40.
The player crouches through the kitchen: Dog must not see it ("Don't let him spot you!"; seen, his script sets off his collar and the gas, SCPT 0x0100F121). Seen at a run, round 18 [observed].

A player who goes through the kitchen unseen sneaks well: seen before the three valves are shut, Dog kills himself and the gas burns the player (SCPT 0x0100F121 [observed]). Crouched at Sneak 17 the bot was seen at 713 units in round 19 [observed]; Sneak raised as a stand-in for a stealthy character.

And a Stealth Boy, as a player going through unseen uses one: at Sneak 100, crouched, Dog still saw the bot at 436 units in the lit kitchen (round 20 [observed: detection log, visual 76.8]). Its Chameleon effect counts in detection (fnv_game::detection).

Who talks in the kitchen is fixed by the kitchen setup activator's first GameMode (SCPT 0x0100F121): YUPTTW.esm's copy, which the TTW game loads, makes Dog the one in control (NVDLC01DogDialogue.bDogAlly 1) for this state; DeadMoney.esm's own copy needs bAct2Cage 0 [observed: round 21 in-game GREETING 0x01011DA0, headless 0x0100F330]. The chain's plugins have no YUPTTW, so the ally flag is set as YUPTTW sets it (stand-in).
The valves shut unseen, Dog finds the player and talks; the player refuses him (DogTopic051, INFO 0x010124E1: stage 50, God turns Dog on the player).

actions.label: Dog in the kitchen (you'll kill yourself)
Dog in the kitchen: the fight

actions.text: No read of stage 50 here: Dog's fight is short, and in the game any wait in his cell after his death runs out his collar's 10 s (a read of done.50 waited 21 s and the player died, round 27 [observed]). Stage 60 is read outside the kitchen.

The fight (stand-in: kill, the player as killer). With the three gas valves shut Dog's death does not set off the collars; the quest script (NVDLC01MQ03aSCRIPT) sees stage 50 done and Dog dead and sets 60.

Dog dead in the kitchen, his collar's death timer runs while the player stays in his cell (SCPT 0x01006E92: NVDLC01DeathTimer, then Dean, Christine and the player die) [observed: round 21, the player died at step 62]. The kitchen back door opens from inside only with the maintenance pass Dog carries (SCPT 0x01010DD8: the pass and nGasTraps 3); the player takes it from his body (looting stand-in) and leaves by it.

To the back door, then out once the quest script has set 60. The door's OnActivate (SCPT 0x01010DD8 [observed: script decompile]) sets MQ03a 100 when 100 is not done, and the quest script (SCPT 0x01013C19) sets 60 only while 100 is not done, on its own tick (quest scripts run every 5 s by default, and not while Dog's death message is up): out at once, 60 never comes (headless and in game, pilot sweep 2: stage 100, not 60 [observed]). Dog dying in the kitchen sets his collar's timer to 20 s (his OnDeath, SCPT 0x01005D10: NVDLC01DeathTimer 20 in cell 0x010038DF [observed]); the walk to the door and one tick of the quest script fit in it. The stage is read at the door, before it sets 100.

actions.label: MQ03a 60 set by the quest script
milestone: Put the Beast Down 60 (Dog killed)
out of the kitchen with the pass

actions.text: Curtain Call at the Tampico (NVDLC01MQ03b). Travel to the theater (stand-in): the player picks up the key trigger's spot by the door (stage 15) and steps into the hall's first trigger, which starts the theater's sequence (TheaterCodeBox state 1): Dean appears on the scaffold and his dialogue package (GREETING) is started here by hand.

The Tampico's route (DeadMoney.esm, cell NVDLC01Theater 0x010046AC [observed: fnvtool esm decode, nav path]): the hall's invisible speakers (NVDLC01SpeakerINV, 768 units, SetDestroyed 1 by their own script SCPT 0x01006E8E, so the player cannot switch them off) are TheaterSpeakerInv01REF over the entrance (-306, 1968, 7660), Inv02 over the south backstage door (-1456, 2336, 7658), Inv03 by the north hall door (358, 3724, 7567) and Inv04 (-208, 3856, 7664); the destructible ones (NVDLC01SpeakerDest, shot) are TheaterSpeakerDest01REF over the entrance (355, 1936, 7547), Dest02 (-2257, 2963, 7568) and 0x0100ED49 (-2104, 3728, 7568) on the backstage corridor. The hall's middle aisle (the first trigger and Vera's sheet music, about (-300, 2980)) is out of every speaker's range. Their one off switch, the Ambient Audio Control terminal (REFR 0x01004EFA at (-1708, 2443, 7453)), stands beyond the Stage Door (TheaterStageDoorREF 0x0100C4B2, lock 255, no key), which TheaterCodeBox unlocks only at the show's end (SCPT 0x0100E89D, state 3); before that every way to it is locked (nav path: unreachable without opening locked doors). So a player crosses the entrance quickly (shooting Dest01), keeps to the middle aisle and visits the terminal after the show.

Vera's sheet music (TheaterVeraPartitureActivatorREF, inside the first trigger's box) gives the Backstage Key (SCPT 0x0100FFD4), which opens the north Backstage Door (0x010047AA); behind it, by Dean's dressing room, lies Vera's Backstage Key (0x0100E8C9, opens Vera's Dressing Room Door 0x010047AB). In Vera's dressing room lie Dean's holotape and Vera's Master Key (0x01004EB6), which opens the projector booth's door (VaultProjectorDoorREF 0x0100E8A7, lock 255) and the south Backstage Door (0x010047B0) back to the hall [observed: REFR XLOC, nav path with and without the keys]. The sheet music is taken at once, while the theater is still in state 1 (it sets state 1 again), and its message box is closed.

actions.label: theater state after the first trigger

actions.text: Dean (who dislikes the player: attitude below 0) taunts from the scaffold; the greeting's end sets stage 20 and the theater's holograms wake.

actions.label: Curtain Call 20 (Dean met in the theater)
the Backstage Key from Vera's sheet music

actions.text: The player finds Dean's old holotape in the theater (picked up: its OnAdd adds the note, stage 30) and plays it on the projector (message box, button 0; stage 40): the show starts and the holograms stand down.
The show runs about 45 s (TheaterCodeBox's timers); at its end Elijah's intercom tells the player to deal with Dean, the stage door unlocks and the box moves to state 3.

The show over, the Stage Door is unlocked: the player goes through it to the Ambient Audio Control terminal and powers off the ambient audio, which switches off the invisible speakers (SetDestroyed 0, Activate, SetDestroyed 1, TERM 0x01004F07 [observed: script decompile]) before Dean's fight on the stage beside them.

Dean still hates the player (attitude -2 from part 1), so every answer ends in a fight: the player passes his Speech 75 check, hears him out and he attacks anyway (stage 50). The path where he hands over the key (INFO 0x010132A7, stage 100) needs a liked Dean. The fight is stood in by kill; Dean's OnDeath gives the player his key and pass, starts his collar's death timer (the player leaves the theater's cell before it runs out) and the quest script sets stage 60.

The player walks back out through the hall (the first trigger's spot, out of the stage speakers' range, one frame there so their distance check sees the player leave) and on to the theater's exit into the lobby, whose trigger sets stage 100.

actions.label: milestone: NVDLC01MQ03b 100 (Curtain Call at the Tampico done)

actions.text: Last Luxuries (NVDLC01MQ03c). Travel up into the Salida del Sol suites to Christine (stand-in); on the suites' first frame their setup script makes her an ally if she likes the player. The conversation is started by hand (soft: the placed triggers running the suites' conversation script are in the lobby and the restaurant, so a player reaches her by walking up and talking).
Christine is killed in the suites (fight stand-in: kill, the player as killer); Last Luxuries' quest script sees her dead with the quest below 100 and sets 30.
